name: Should I choose a floating or a floor-mounted custom vanity?
description: Choose based on aesthetics and storage needs; floating offers a modern look and easier cleaning but less storage, while floor-mounted provides more storage.

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a floating or a floor-mounted custom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between a floating and a floor-mounted custom vanity depends on your aesthetic preference and practical needs. Floating vanities offer a modern look and can make a small bathroom appear larger, providing easier floor cleaning. However, they typically offer less storage capacity than floor-mounted options. Floor-mounted vanities generally provide more robust storage and a traditional aesthetic. Consider your storage requirements and the existing plumbing layout, as a floating vanity might require minor plumbing adjustments for optimal placement and support.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose based on aesthetics and storage needs; floating offers a modern look and easier cleaning but less storage, while floor-mounted provides more storage.
